explanation.text:
ORKLA ASA (org.nr 910 747 711) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1918-02-27, registered 1995-03-12. Business address: Drammensveien 149A, 0277 OSLO. Main industry (NACE): 10.850 Produksjon av ferdigmat. Registered employees: 72 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 95,000,000; operating result NOK -467,000,000; net result NOK 9,191,000,000; total assets NOK 83,432,000,000; equity NOK 65,515,000,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 71,807,000,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Nils Kloumann Selte; board chair Christer Kjos; 9 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. LEI: 549300PZS8G8RG6RVZ52 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orkla_ASA.
